lemma time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema {A : ElectromagneticPotential d}
    {𝓕 : FreeSpace}
    (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A) (J : LorentzCurrentDensity d)
    (hJ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ J) (h : IsExtrema 𝓕 A J)
    (t : Time) (x : Space d) (i : Fin d) :
    ∂ₜ (∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i)) t =
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * ∑ j, (∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x) -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * 𝓕.μ₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
  have hA2 : ContDiff ℝ 3 A := hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)
  have hEs : ∀ j, ContDiff ℝ 2 (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j) :=
    fun j => electricField_apply_contDiff_space hA2 t
  have hEd := fun j k => Space.deriv_differentiable (hEs j) k
  have hB : ∀ j, ContDiff ℝ 2 ↿(fun s y => A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c s y (j, i)) :=
    fun j => magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff _ hA2 (j, i)
  have hBt := fun j => Space.space_deriv_differentiable_time (i := j) (hB j) x
  have hJt := LorentzCurrentDensity.currentDensity_apply_differentiable_time (c := 𝓕.c)
    (hJ.differentiable (by decide)) x i
  have hcurl (j : Fin d) :
      ∂ₜ (fun s => ∂[j] (A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c s · (j, i)) x) t =
      ∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x -
      ∂[i] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j)) x := by
    rw [Space.time_deriv_comm_space_deriv (hB j)]
    simp_rw [time_deriv_magneticFieldMatrix A (hA2.of_le (by decide))]
    rw [Space.fun_deriv_sub _ _ (hEd i j) (hEd j i), Space.deriv_commute _ (hEs j)]
  have hdiv : (∑ j, ∂[i] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j)) x) =
      1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x := by
    have hg := (isExtrema_iff_gauss_ampere_magneticFieldMatrix hA J hJ).mp h
    calc
      _ = ∂[i] (fun y => ∑ j, ∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j) y) x := by
        rw [Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis,
          fderiv_fun_sum (fun j _ => (hEd j j).differentiableAt)]
        simp only [_root_.sum_apply, ← Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis]
      _ = ∂[i] (fun y => 1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t y) x := by
        congr 1
        funext y
        exact (hg t y).1.trans (by ring)
      _ = _ := by
        rw [Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis,
          fderiv_const_mul (LorentzCurrentDensity.chargeDensity_differentiable_space
            (hJ.differentiable (by decide)) t).differentiableAt]
        rfl
  have he : ∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i) = fun s =>
      1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∑ j, ∂[j] (A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c s · (j, i)) x -
      1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * J.currentDensity 𝓕.c s x i := by
    funext s
    rw [Time.deriv_euclid (electricField_differentiable_time (hA2.of_le (by decide)) x),
      time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema hA J hJ h]
  rw [he, Time.deriv_eq,
    fderiv_fun_sub ((Differentiable.fun_sum fun j _ => hBt j).const_mul _).differentiableAt
      (hJt.const_mul _).differentiableAt,
    fderiv_const_mul (Differentiable.fun_sum fun j _ => hBt j).differentiableAt,
    fderiv_const_mul hJt.differentiableAt,
    fderiv_fun_sum (fun j _ => (hBt j).differentiableAt)]
  simp only [_root_.sub_apply, _root_.smul_apply, _root_.sum_apply, smul_eq_mul,
    ← Time.deriv_eq, hcurl, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, hdiv, FreeSpace.c_sq]
  field_simp
